description: Infrastructures de recharge pour (organisation ELECTRICITE VEIT) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ELECTRICITE VEIT. This dataset meets the specifications of the diagram “Electric vehicle charging infrastructure” available on [schema.data.gouv.fr](. Coverage: ELECTRICITE VEIT. The portal shows the English title as "Charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (organisation ELECTRICITE VEIT)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ELECTRICITE VEIT. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
